log.label: 22-identify-udc
log.verdict:
beyond table
The combination is colour-neutral, but this table covers light hadrons (u, d, s) only. The real particle: Λ_c⁺ (charm baryon) — discovered 1975. Creating it needs ≈ 2.5 GeV of collision energy — heavy quarks are made in accelerators, not built by hand.

log.label: 23-ccbar-attempt
log.verdict: Fill every slot, then press Identify particle.

log.label: 24-identify-ccbar
log.verdict:
beyond table
The combination is colour-neutral, but this table covers light hadrons (u, d, s) only. The real particle: J/ψ (charmonium, cc̄) — discovered 1974. Creating it needs ≈ 2.5 GeV of collision energy — heavy quarks are made in accelerators, not built by hand.

log.label: 25-identify-uuu-j12
log.verdict:
no known particle
This combination is colour-neutral, but there is no known particle with these quarks at spin ½. At other spins, these quarks form: Δ⁺⁺ (J=3⁄2).
